title: Yusuf
tagline: His whole story in thirteen chapters, with something to touch and do in every one.
depictionNotes: People are drawn, all with dark skin, including Prophet Yusuf and Prophet Yaqub (peace be upon them), shown with faces by the owner's decision for this game. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ does not appear. The events in the governor's house (12:23-34) and the second prisoner's dream (12:41) are told in softened, child-level words; the game's 'For parents' note says exactly how.
